propositions: Jira Cloud and Data Center identify users differently (accountId vs name), and PR #120 implemented assignee resolution by copying resolve_assignee with hardcoded is_account_id=False, making the authoritative branch unreachable for DC and causing permanent non-authoritative resolution that drives assignee-diff churn

A UserIdentityModel Protocol with resolve() and to_payload() methods must formalize the contract, with AccountIdIdentity for Cloud and NameIdentity for DC, where NameIdentity performs real lookup against the user-search endpoint to return authoritative=True and enable diff convergence
NameIdentity must receive its resolver as an explicit constructor parameter rather than via getattr, eliminating the unreachable branch and silent failures of PR #120's design

The identity model implementations must pass a shared parameterized contract test covering the three resolution states (empty yields non-authoritative, same identity yields authoritative converged, different identity yields authoritative changed) and model-specific payload shape tests
